ops.body:
Cover ancestors (Recommended)
Question: Option B's listing guard matches only HOME itself and the pool anchors. Listings rooted at a parent of those still get through: `rg --files -g AGENTS.md ~/.claude` walks the whole worktree pool, and so do `rg --files /Users` and `rg --files /`. Should R4 also block listings rooted at HOME's parents and at the parents of the pools (`~/.claude`, `~/.orca`)?
Options: Cover ancestors (Recommended) | Only HOME's parents | Option B as written
